flags.effect: Show the commits, the files, the build and whether a call is running, and change nothing
flags.name: --dry-run

flags.effect: The hash of the reviewed plan; the update stops when the plan has changed
flags.name: --plan-hash

flags.effect: The command to run in the checkout after the update (stops after 2 minutes); it is remembered for this server while its text stays the same
flags.name: --build

flags.effect: Change the files only, even when a build command is remembered
flags.name: --no-build

flags.effect: Restart even when a call is running; the call ends
flags.name: --restart-now

flags.effect: Seconds to wait for the gateways' answers to the restart
flags.name: --wait

flags.effect: Fetch the tracked remote first, so the plan sees what was pushed since the last check
flags.name: --fetch

summary: Fast-forward a server's checkout, run the agreed build and restart it: <server> [--dry-run] [--plan-hash] [--build|--no-build] [--restart-now|--no-restart]
